title: Saffron City Gym Leader
threat_analysis: Sabrina commands a lethal Psychic arsenal engineered around Special setup and high-speed destruction. Her lead Hypno/Mr. Mime attempts to boost Special Attack via Nasty Plot and pass boosts or land Hypnosis sleep. Espeon/Umbreon establishes defensive Light Screen while firing Dark Pulse and Future Sight. Alakazam/Slowbro shores up physical bulk with Amnesia and Recover while retaliating with Surf and Psycho Cut. Her terrifying Ace, Gengar/Alakazam (Ghost/Psychic with Levitate), boasts a staggering 130 Special Attack and 120 Speed; it sets up Calm Mind, strikes with STAB Shadow Ball and Psycho Cut, and carries Destiny Bond to take down your sweeper if pushed to critical health.
tactical_counter_plan: Bulbasaur Team Strategy: Venusaur/Aegislash (or Doublade) completely walls Psychic moves with its Steel typing, ignores Poison, and retaliates with super-effective Shadow Claw or Iron Head. Gyarados/Arbok or Snorlax absorbs Special hits and punishes with Crunch and Bite.

Charmander Team Strategy: Charizard sets up early offensive pressure. Dark-type fusions such as Houndoom/Primeape or Arbok/Dugtrio outspeed and dismantle Sabrina's Psychic core with STAB Crunch, Sucker Punch, and Night Slash. Beware of Gengar/Alakazam's Destiny Bond—bait the move or use priority to finish it.

Squirtle Team Strategy: Blastoise pairs with Dark or Ghost coverage; Bite and Dark Pulse hit every member for super-effective damage. Alakazam/Weezing or Snorlax tanks Gengar/Alakazam's hits and responds with Shadow Ball or Crunch.

Countering Destiny Bond & Levitate: Gengar/Alakazam is immune to Ground moves via Levitate. Do not attack blindly with physical contact moves when its health is under 25% to avoid triggering Destiny Bond; use non-damaging setup moves or status, then finish with priority (Shadow Sneak, Sucker Punch, Bite).
rewards: Marsh Badge (Ensures obedience of all traded/fused Pokémon up to Lv. 70)
